pending-clause.answer: Read §2002:8.8.1.1 (evaluation order and exponentiation exceptions, which 'apply regardless of the mode of arithmetic'), §2002:8.8.1.3.1 with §2002:8.8.1.3.1.1 ('with a precision of 32 decimal digits') and §2002:8.8.1.3.1.3 (rounded to 31 digits), §2002:8.8.1.3.6 (exponentiation), and §2002:15 / §2002:15.1 (2002's 15 holds 2023's 15.1 General list; 2002 15.1 adds that the function definition gives an alphanumeric/national function's character positions and lacks 2023 15.2's type-determination sentence; the six function types are the same).
